summary: Frontend-only retest of iteration_307 fixes + sample of the MoneyInput sweep on the static build (admin@kainnusantara.id, entity KSC). FIX 1 (Makloon wizard) PASS: wizard-material-price (mode 'Beli + Proses'), wizard-rate-1 and wizard-aux-amount-1-0 are all type=text inputMode=decimal with the 'Rp' prefix inside the box and a live preview 'Rp 51.500'; wizard step 1 -> step 2 navigation works, step-level validation ('Langkah 1: produk hasil (output) wajib dipilih') fires correctly, no console errors. FIX 2 (Kontrak Internal) PASS: interco-contract-seller / -buyer / -product KNSelect triggers now update on option select (trigger text changed from 'Pilih...' to 'KSC' / 'Kanda' / 'SGK-PLB-001 · Songket Palembang Benang Emas'); interco-contract-rate preview 'Rp 88.000'; 'Terbitkan Kontrak Internal' SUCCEEDED (modal closed, no error) with distinct entities, and correctly showed the business validation 'PT penjual & pembeli harus berbeda' when both were KSC. FIX 4 PASS: tax-pph-modal now closes with the ESC key. FIX 3 NOT TESTABLE in the UI (no 'Buat Kontrabon' entry point / no ready bills in demo data) - source-verified as MoneyInput (ContraBonCreateWizard.jsx:302-304). SWEEP verified live (Rp prefix + `${testId}-preview` + typing keeps state): customer-credit-limit (Rp 150.000), lead-form-value (Rp 150.000), ar-receipt-amount (FIFO mode, Rp 150.000), employee-salary-input (Rp 5.000.000 AND persisted: saved on EMP edit then reopened -> 5000000), veh-log-bbm/tol/parkir/lain (Rp 50.000 each, veh-log-total recomputed to Rp 200.000), contract-rate + contract-min-charge (ContractFormModal, Rp 120.000), blanket-value-cap (Rp 10.000.000, 'Plafon Efektif' recomputed). ZERO page/React errors and no blank screens on any screen visited (Makloon, Interco, Kontrabon, Pajak/PPh, CRM Pelanggan/Leads/Penagihan, SDM Karyawan, Kendaraan, Produk & Harga, Master Pembelian, Blanket PO). 3 NEW un-converted monetary fields found (see ui_bugs).

ui_bugs.issue: Rupiah fields 'Target Penjualan (Rp)' and 'Target Pencairan (Rp)' still use the local NumberField helper (<input type="number">) - no Rp prefix, no preview. Extra problem: these reuse the SAME testids as the converted SalesForceDashboard fields (target-sales-amount / target-collection-amount), so testids are duplicated across two screens.

Inconsistent conversion inside the same modal: 'Otomatis (FIFO)' amount is MoneyInput (ar-receipt-amount PASS) but the 'Manual per Pesanan' per-order Rupiah allocation inputs are still <input type="number"> (verified live: ar-receipt-alloc-so_001 / -so_006 type=number, no Rp prefix, no preview) while the modal footer shows 'Total dibayar: Rp 5.571.200'.

po-amend-new-price was converted to MoneyInput but the EXISTING item-line price column in the same table is still <input type="number"> (po-amend-item-price-{i}, line 234) - same modal shows two different money widgets.

tax-pph-modal was fixed, but the same trap remains on: ar-receipt-modal (CRM -> Penagihan -> collection-pay-*), ContractFormModal 'Kontrak Baru' (Master Pembelian -> Kontrak Mitra & Supplier) and the Blanket PO create modal - ESC does nothing and the overlay swallows sidebar clicks, which blocked navigation during testing (had to use their own close testid).

integration_issues.issue: NOT TESTABLE: on Hutang Pemasok -> Kontrabon there is no 'Buat Kontrabon' trigger reachable in current demo data (same blocker as iteration_307: SUP-00007 has 0 ready bills), so cb-create-amount-{billId} never renders. Code inspection confirms it is now MoneyInput (disabled until the bill row is picked).
NOT TESTABLE: Produk & Harga -> Template & Varian has 0 templates in demo data ('Belum ada template.'), so the generator modal with gen-base-price cannot be opened.

NOT TESTABLE via UI: crm-tab-salesforce renders no button whose testid contains 'target'; could not find the trigger that opens the SalesForceDashboard target modal (target-sales-amount / target-collection-amount there ARE MoneyInput in source, SalesForceDashboard.jsx:292-294).

issues: MoneyInput itself renders consistently (Rp prefix never blocks typing, preview always right below).

Date inputs are still native browser pickers showing US 'mm/dd/yyyy' (interco 'Berlaku sejak' 09/04/2026, veh-log-tanggal, blanket Berlaku Mulai/Sampai, contract Berlaku dari/sampai) in an Indonesian UI - unchanged from iteration_307.
In veh-log-* the value is right-aligned while the 'Rp' prefix is left-aligned, leaving a wide empty gap between them (cosmetic).

action_items: Convert crm/IncentiveSchemeEditor.jsx NumberField Rp fields to MoneyInput AND rename their testids (currently duplicated with SalesForceDashboard target-sales-amount / target-collection-amount).
Convert ar-receipt-alloc-{orderId} in crm/ARReceiptModal.jsx to MoneyInput (Manual per Pesanan tab).
Convert po-amend-item-price-{i} in admin/po/POAmendModal.jsx to MoneyInput.
Add useEscapeClose/overlayDismiss to ARReceiptModal, ContractFormModal and BlanketPOCreateModal (same fix already applied to tax-pph-modal).

Seed data so the remaining fields become reachable: a supplier with ready bills (cb-create-amount), at least one variant template (gen-base-price), and expose the Sales Force target modal trigger with a data-testid.

Cleanup test data created this iteration: internal contract KSC -> Kanda for SGK-PLB-001 at Rp 88.000 (issued via Terbitkan Kontrak Internal), and EMP-0001x base_salary set to 5.000.000 (employee emp_33ce7bf4bec1 - was changed to verify persistence).
critical_code_review_comments: The 'MoneyInput everywhere' sweep is still per-file rather than per-widget: three files (ARReceiptModal, POAmendModal, IncentiveSchemeEditor) contain BOTH a MoneyInput and a leftover <input type="number"> money field. A repo-wide grep for `type="number"` next to labels containing '(Rp)' would close the gap faster than file-by-file review.
Duplicate data-testid across screens (target-sales-amount in both SalesForceDashboard and IncentiveSchemeEditor) makes automated verification ambiguous - testids should be unique per screen.

Several modals still lack the shared useEscapeClose/overlayDismiss helpers that MakloonWizard and TaxCenterView now use; adding them at the modal shell level would prevent this class of navigation-trap bug.

success_rate.frontend: 13/13 reachable MoneyInput fields PASS; FIX1/FIX2/FIX4 PASS; FIX3 + 3 sweep fields not testable in demo data; 3 new un-converted money inputs found

seed_data_creation: No seed scripts run. Created/changed via UI: 1 internal contract (KSC seller -> Kanda buyer, SGK-PLB-001, Rp 88.000, valid from 09/04/2026) issued successfully; employee emp_33ce7bf4bec1 base_salary saved as 5.000.000 (persistence check). Makloon wizard, CRM customer/lead, vehicle log, contract, blanket PO and AR receipt modals were filled but NOT saved.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Navigation notes discovered this run: sidebar ids are nav-customers-crm (CRM, inner tabs crm-tab-customers/leads/interactions/collection/salesforce/rates/schemes/approvals), nav-products-pricing (hub-tab-md-products/product-templates/pricelist/cs-price-list), nav-hr-people (hub-tab-hr-employees, create-employee-button / edit-employee-{id}), nav-vehicle-logs (veh-log-create-btn -> veh-log-modal), nav-master-pembelian (hub-tab-supplier-contracts -> contracts-create-button), nav-purchase-orders (hub-tab-blanket-po -> blanket-create-button). rca_of_the_issue: Both HIGH defects from iteration_307 are genuinely fixed at the render tree level: MakloonWizard.jsx:371 and MakloonStepEditor.jsx:304/405 now import and render MoneyInput (verified in the live static build, chunk 5812 contains wizard-material-price), and InternalContractWizardModal.jsx:99-105 now passes onValueChange to KNSelect so the controlled seller/buyer/product state updates and the POST succeeds. The remaining findings are the same root cause as before - the sweep matched files, not individual money widgets - leaving a MoneyInput and a raw type=number money field side by side in ARReceiptModal, POAmendModal and IncentiveSchemeEditor.
